run_versiongenerate: run versiongenerate.py to extract version from configure.ac and generate Version.h
build_version_header: build a Version.h header file with GTEST_VERSIONINFO_SHORT and GTEST_VERSIONINFO_LONG defines
test_version_extraction: test the regex extraction of major, minor, and fix version from AC_INIT macro
review_versiongenerate: review the versiongenerate.py script that parses configure.ac for gtest framework versioning
summarize_versiongenerate: summarize how versiongenerate.py reads configure.ac and writes Version.h for Info.plist substitution
